The '''Niorde system''' was an uncharted [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Niorde]] and its native [[Niordi]] were located in this system. A [[Niordi secret laboratory|secret laboratory]] was located on the fringes of the Niorde system.
